key_insight: PROMOTE bounds the probability of ever falsely promoting a trading rule despite adaptive candidate creation, dependent tests, and indefinite monitoring.
engineering_relevance: Financial research agents can use PROMOTE as a cost-aware statistical gate before promoting strategies discovered through continuous experimentation.
method: Assign each candidate predictable testing wealth at birth, with lifetime allocations totaling at most one.
Accumulate a cost-aware e-process using only post-birth returns.
Apply a weighted Ville bound to control false promotion under the declared bounded-score null.
evidence_signal: Across 3,000 shared-sign null paths testing 24 hypotheses, false-family crossings were 94.5% for repeated unadjusted tests versus 0.0% for PROMOTE; a separate adaptive mean-zero experiment recorded 1.77% across 3,000 programs.
watch_item: The certificate controls historical false promotion under the declared null, not future profitability; the market replay produced no promotions after costs.
paper_title: Can We Stop the Backtest Yet? Anytime-Valid Promotion Tests for Adaptive Financial Research Agents
